retention.narrative: ₹4,50,000 has left for an external broker (ZERODHA), and it is recurring. That is 41% of what Rajesh holds with us. Two more like this and the relationship is gone — worth a call before it is.

note: The counter-offer was withheld: it did not pass the suitability checks for this customer (Leaves 2.4 months of expenses liquid, against a 6-month buffer.). The outflow is still worth a call — but not with this product.
